title: Thanksgiving week: Dell, Best Buy & NVDA vol
card_lines: $DELL: options imply ~12-16% move on Nov 24 earnings
$BBY: ~10% implied move Nov 24; Telsey lifted PT to $110
$NVDA: IV rank fell 100 to ~59 after a 0.4x priced move
short: Weekly options watch: $DELL prices a ~12-16% earnings move (Nov 24), $BBY ~10% after a PT hike, $NVDA vol reset post-print. VIX ~24-25. https://analystledger.github.io #options #stocks
long:
Weekly options watch for Thanksgiving week: here is what the options market is pricing heading into a holiday-shortened week (closed Thu Nov 26, half-day Fri), with VIX hovering around 24-25 and the October PCE report due Wed Nov 25.

• $DELL — reports Tue Nov 24 after the close. Options imply a post-earnings move of roughly 12-16% depending on source, well above a typical large-cap print. Put open interest clusters near $300-310 and calls near $400, framing the range traders are watching.

• $BBY — reports Tue Nov 24 before the open with an implied move near ±9.6%. Telsey Advisory raised its price target to $110 (Outperform) this week, making it a read on holiday-season consumer demand.

• $NVDA — after pricing a ~7.7% earnings-day move, shares moved about 0.4x that amount and IV rank dropped from 100 to ~59. It also drew 14 analyst actions on our tracker this week, including six price-target cuts and two downgrades. Watch whether implied volatility keeps resetting lower.

Also on deck: $HPE (±14%), $WDAY, $ADSK, $HPQ and $DE.

Track every rating change free at https://analystledger.github.io

Educational only — not investment advice.

title: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as CEO
card_lines: $NVDA: Huang reinstated as CEO, effective now
Stock opened up ~33%, biggest gain since 2003
short: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned. $NVDA opened up ~33%, lifting chip and AI-infrastructure stocks. SEC inquiry still open. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #stocks
long:
Nvidia's board has reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as president and CEO, effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned.

• $NVDA opened up about 33%, its biggest intraday gain since 2003 (Bloomberg).
• Chipmakers and AI-infrastructure names rallied, including neocloud providers $CRWV and $NBIS.
• Still open: an SEC inquiry, shareholder lawsuits and national-security questions.

Sources and every analyst rating change: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#stocks #Nvidia

title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for ~$43.9B
card_lines: 1.135 CRWD shares per ZS share (~34% premium)
short: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth ~$43.9B (1.135 $CRWD per $ZS share, ~34% premium). $CRWD fell ~9% pre-open. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #cybersecurity #stocks
long:
CrowdStrike has agreed to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion (Reuters).

• Zscaler holders get 1.135 $CRWD shares per $ZS share, about a 34% premium.
• $CRWD fell about 9% before the open as investors weighed dilution; $ZS jumped.
• The combination creates a stronger rival to $PANW. Shareholder and regulatory approvals are still needed.

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#cybersecurity #stocks

title: US stocks rebound after last week's rout
card_lines: Chip index up ~13%; energy only sector down
Follows an 8.6% weekly drop in the S&P 500
short: US stocks bounced Monday: Nasdaq up ~6.7%, S&P 500 ~4.9% by midday, chip stocks up ~13% after last week's 8.6% S&P drop. A December Fed hike is still priced in. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #stocks #markets
long:
US stocks staged a sharp rebound on Monday after one of the worst weeks in years.

• By midday the Nasdaq Composite was up about 6.7% and the S&P 500 about 4.9%
• The Philadelphia semiconductor index rose roughly 13%; energy was the only sector lower
• Last week the S&P 500 fell 8.6% and confirmed a correction; futures still price a likely December Fed hike

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#stocks #markets #AnalystLedger

title: Arm keeps CEO Rene Haas through 2033
card_lines: He also becomes SoftBank vice chairman Dec 1
short: $ARM extended CEO Rene Haas's contract through 2033; he also becomes SoftBank vice chairman Dec 1. Nvidia had reportedly approached him earlier this month. Shares rose ~16%. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #Arm #semiconductors
long:
Arm said on Monday that CEO Rene Haas, who has run the chip designer since 2022, will stay in the role through 2033.

• Haas also becomes vice chairman of majority owner SoftBank Group from December 1
• Nvidia's board had reportedly approached him earlier this month during its CEO search
• $ARM shares rose about 16% on Monday

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#Arm #semiconductors #AnalystLedger

title: Tesla jumps on SpaceX merger reports
card_lines: $TSLA up as much as 13.9% on Monday
Bloomberg: SpaceX deal could come in December
HSBC upgrades to hold, target $359 from $157
short: $TSLA rose as much as 13.9% Monday after Bloomberg reported a possible SpaceX merger as soon as December and HSBC upgraded to hold. No deal has been announced. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #Tesla #stocks
long:
Tesla shares rose sharply on Monday amid merger reports and a broad tech rebound.

• $TSLA gained as much as 13.9% intraday
• Bloomberg reported a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger could come as soon as December; nothing has been officially announced
• HSBC upgraded the stock to hold from reduce and lifted its target to $359 from $157

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#Tesla #stocks #AnalystLedger

title: Sanofi to buy Insmed for ~$41B
card_lines: About 46% premium to Nov. 18 unaffected close
Expected to close in first half of 2027
short: Sanofi ($SNY) agreed to buy Insmed ($INSM) for $175/share in cash, about $41B, a ~46% premium to the unaffected price. Needs shareholder and regulatory approval. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #biotech #stocks
long:
Sanofi has agreed to acquire Insmed in an all-cash deal announced Tuesday.

• $INSM holders would receive $175 per share, an equity value of about $41.0 billion
• The price is about a 46% premium to Insmed's Nov. 18 unaffected close
• $SNY expects to close in the first half of 2027, subject to Insmed shareholder approval and regulatory clearances

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#biotech #MergersAndAcquisitions #AnalystLedger

title: HPE slides despite Q4 beat
card_lines: FY27 EPS outlook raised; $5B more in buybacks
CFO flags AI server margin pressure in 2H FY27
short: $HPE fell premarket despite a Q4 beat (revenue $14.5B, +50%), a raised FY27 outlook and a new $5B buyback, after warning AI server sales could weigh on margins. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #HPE #AI
long:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares dropped before Tuesday's open even though results beat expectations.

• $HPE fiscal Q4 revenue rose 50% to $14.5 billion; non-GAAP EPS was $1.43
• Fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS outlook raised to $5.05-$5.35, plus an extra $5 billion buyback
• The CFO warned rising AI server sales could weigh on margins in the second half of fiscal 2027

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#HPE #AI #earnings #AnalystLedger

title: Dollar Tree beats and lifts outlook
short: $DLTR rose premarket after Q3 adj. EPS of $1.16 vs $0.91 expected, comps +4.6% and a raised FY outlook of $8.05-$8.25, incl. ~$0.65 from tariff refunds. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #retail #earnings
long:
Dollar Tree shares rose before the open after third-quarter results came in ahead of estimates.

• $DLTR adjusted EPS was $1.16 versus a $0.91 consensus; net sales rose 6.9% to $5.07 billion
• Comparable store sales grew 4.6%, led by a 3.8% gain in traffic
• Full-year adjusted EPS outlook raised to $8.05-$8.25, including about $0.65 from tariff refunds

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#retail #earnings #AnalystLedger

title: ADI beats, but stock sinks ~17%
card_lines: Q1 adj. EPS guide $3.82; FY27 capex up to $1.9B
short: $ADI fell ~17% premarket despite record Q4 revenue of $4.37B (+42% YoY) and adj. EPS of $4.06 vs ~$3.89 est., as Q1 EPS guidance stepped down and capex jumps. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #semiconductors #earnings
long:
Analog Devices delivered a clear beat, yet the stock slid sharply as investors focused on guidance and spending.

• $ADI fiscal Q4 revenue rose 42% to $4.37B; adjusted EPS of $4.06 topped the ~$3.89 consensus
• Q1 guidance: revenue $4.4B ±$150M, adjusted EPS $3.82 ±$0.20
• Fiscal 2027 capex planned at $1.6–1.9B vs $0.7B in fiscal 2026; shares fell ~17% premarket

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#semiconductors #earnings #AnalystLedger

title: Chip stocks reverse Monday's AI surge
short: A day after a ~31% jump, $NVDA fell ~7-9% Tuesday as $AMD (~-9%) and $MU (-10%+) also slid; the Nasdaq dropped ~2% while the Dow rose on a rotation to defensives. https://analystledger.github.io/news.html #stocks #AI
long:
The AI hardware trade swung sharply in reverse on Tuesday, one session after its biggest rally in months.

• $NVDA fell roughly 7-9% after jumping about 31% Monday on Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO
• $AMD lost about 9%; $MU and SK Hynix dropped more than 10%; storage names fell 5%+
• Nasdaq was down about 1.5-2% while the Dow gained as money moved into healthcare and retail

Sources: https://analystledger.github.io/news.html

#stocks #AI #AnalystLedger
